subject: Eval kickoff: Acme / Redwood - scheduling and trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval kickoff: Acme / Redwood - next steps

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Acme's customer support summarization pipeline (latency < 300ms P95, cost target <$0.002/token, and >= 90% topline fidelity on your prompt set).
- Scope: 2-week evaluation focused on a 1000-prompt sample (mix of short/long conversations), 1 model variant, and a locked config for fair comparison.
- Success criteria: latency, cost, and prompt-set-based quality metrics (we'll capture anchor metrics during the kickoff).

Next step: schedule a 45-minute evaluation kickoff where we walk through the trial plan, share the prompt set and evals, and align on roles and logging/access. Connor (CC'd) will own the technical onboarding and can run the initial ingest.

Proposed slots: Monday 6/21 9:30–10:15am PT or Tuesday 6/22 11:00–11:45am PT. If neither works, tell me a couple times that do and Connor or I will adapt.

Attaching a short trial plan (high level) for you to skim ahead of the call.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf (application/pdf)

Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: Acme / Redwood - next steps

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Monday 9:30am PT works for me and Marco. A few quick Qs to prep our side:

1) Can you confirm the data upload mechanism (S3 presigned vs secure share)?
2) We'll want to include a small subset of production conversations that are PII redacted — is that okay?
3) Who should be on the call from Redwood for the step-by-step onboarding?

I see the trial plan attached; I'll share it with our eng lead and legal.

Jill
Jill Thompson
Head of Customer Ops | Acme Corp
jill.thompson@acme.com | +1 212-555-0190

Perfect — locking Monday 6/21 9:30am PT on our side. Calendar invite to follow (I used the Calendly link below for availability).

Responses to your prep Qs:
1) Data upload: we prefer a pre-signed S3 workflow for the initial ingest; Connor will send the presigned POST and a small Python sample.
2) PII: redaction is fine; we can also accept encrypted payloads if you need additional controls.
3) On the kickoff we'll have me (commercial lead) and Connor (solutions engineer) — Connor will take the technical lead for the onboarding steps and initial test run.

Attached is a slightly updated trial plan with the prompt set outline and proposed eval metrics. If you want, I can also add a short checklist for legal/infosec ahead of the call.

See you Monday.

Best,
Marissa
